reviews.comment: Dr. Adams' lectures can get a bit boring at times, but her class isn't difficult because her tests are pretty straightforward to study for. Her exams for the most part test big picture concepts and only sometimes small details. Her exams are basically right off the powerpoints and the book isn't really needed. For the final study the midterm exams.

Adams was a good prof. 214 was tougher than I expected, but she gives you everything you need to know to succeed. Some of the things that were tested felt a little tedious. Go to her office hours. If you have issues about something class related, she'll help you work them out. Overall, not the easiest 214 prof but I'd take her again.
Good lectures and very kind prof. Her exams were very content heavy and you had to know almost every detail to do well. Study hard, but overall, enjoyable class!

Dr. Adams is a good prof. 
Pros: 
-No textbook, good lecture slides. Study/memorize material from slides and do well.
-Participation and extra credit is given out readily.
-VERY helpful during office hours.
Cons:
-Exams can be difficult, many questions over graphs/charts/tables in slides.
-Lots of material to memorize, hard class

Dr. Adams is the most caring and understanding professor I have had. There are a lot of extra credit opportunities that helped me get an A. Other easy points are problem sets and participation during class. Tests are challenging, but many of the questions are based on the slides and understanding of the graphs.

Yes, this class is tough. Yes, you have to work for your A like all of the other students. This is an upper-level biology class so don't expect it to be easy. Dr. Adams was extremely helpful during office hours with homework and general questions. Don't have to read the book but it is a nice reinforcer for content.

Professor Adams is a good choice for this class. She's gives ample extra credit opportunities (bumped me up at least 3%) and has tests that are based off of the lecture slides (no need for textbook). She is VERY helpful in office hours, but not so much through email. My only gripe with this class was lecture pacing. Just pay attention to details.

I thought she was a good professor. The exams were pretty much just like the slides, practice problems, and problems sets. She is kind and wants you to do well, and there were several opportunities for extra credit. You can also tell she is passionate about what she teaches and is a cool person. Def recommend!!

rate: 5/10
date: yes she's super chill and so nice
rate: honestly this class sucked. PowerPoints were super long and there was a TON of material. The exams were oddly specific and you HAVE to understand graphs and diagrams. She does give a ton of extra credit though and pls go to class unlike me.

very sweet prof, lectures can be interesting but very content dense & somewhat disorganized. Exams are straight off the slides, never opened the textbook. some extra credit during lectures. tests are honestly pretty easy, there's just a lot of material in this course

Dr. Adams' lectures were kinda boring and slow. Her lectures did not tell me anything about the test resulting in the tests being much harder than they needed to be. She is super understanding and gives extra credit, but overall this class was unnecessarily hard, especially since most of it was review.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class and Admas was overall pretty average. The material is very specific and kinda difficult, but if you study quite a bit you could probably do well. She doesn't really teach honestly, its just her talking and reading the slides, which is why I pretty much stopped showing up to class. She does do learning catalytics too, but not that often.

Lectures are boring and drawn out, and Adams tends to lecture straight off of slides. Had online exams that tended to be much harder than necessary. Problems were graph and diagram heavy. Understanding of many concepts and memorization of equations needed do exams. Does not provide feedback and is a slow grader.

She is not bad but she is a hard grader and she wont help you throughout the class. The class is boring because she only reads from her slides which are a million each chapter. I wont ever take her again and I barely even passed this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I made an A in BIOL 111, 112, and 213. This class was the first biology I made a B in. Honestly a sweet lady but not a good option if you just want an A. The material is pretty extensive and some of her tests were kind of ridiculous. Gives extra credit but a steep grind to get an A. Would not recommend.

I don't know why there is so many bad reviews. She is really nice and seems to genuinely enjoy the subject. The exams are based solely on her PowerPoints. She likes to include lots of graphs/ diagrams directly from the slides, so make sure you know what they mean. Just pure memorization! B is very doable, just have to put in a bit of work for an A.

This was my first Bio class as a college student and it was rough at the beginning. You have to adapt to their way of teaching, which is ALL memorization. Make note of every single detail. There was an exam where 10 points came from one slide out of the about 180 included on the exam. However, I still felt like I learned a lot in this course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Adams does not care about her students. I have not passed a single exam, she expects you to memorize everything on her slides even graphs. She has made so many passive aggressive comments to students who ask questions in class. DO NOT TAKE HER.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Assignments supposed to be given a week in advance given three days before the due date, material that doesn't make sense in lectures, and panicking during tests because I felt unprepared are a few reasons why I would highly recommend finding a new professor. Not to mention her lack of answering student questions and packing new material onto tests
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She knows a lot about the class clearly but does not give enough time on the tests. The tests are long and hard, you have to know literally every detail from her ridiculously long PowerPoints. My advice would be to go over the PowerPoints multiple times before. It has not been good so far.

Although she is a great professor, it is not good enough to study her lecture slides & do well on an exam. Her course material is easy ,but she ended up making it complex and hard to understand. There's easier professors out there and this isn't supposed to be a hard class. Overall would recommend taking anyone else over her any day of the week.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Adams. Everything you need to know for the problem sets and exams are on her lecture slides so study everything about them! If you need help with anything go to her office hours and she will help you out so much. She does Top Hat for extra credit so go to class Bc she might do a problem or two.
Just know the lecture slides very well (study them repeatedly and memorize the info) and you will get a high B or A on every test.

I took Adams this semester I would not recommend her class to anyone. There's a lot of material to cover but her lectures and slides aren't very specific. She includes additional unneeded information that makes you confused on what to study for the tests. The final was bloody awful.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I am very happy to say that Biol 214 was a very pleasant experience with her! We had a total of 3 midterms and an accumulative final, and after the class had complaints about how the first midterm went, she went out of her way to make the other tests VERY fair, as long as you studied. Take her if you are interested in learning the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Adams is a very nice professor that wants to help her students through the course. She is very accessible outside of class and loves to give advice in order to help students achieve better grades if they are struggling. She is funny and never has a boring lecture. She answers all questions to the best of her ability and explains things perfect.

I don't understand the bad readings. Her class is tough for sure, but you can see she truly loves what she does and really cares about all of her students. She offers tons of extra credit and if you show her you are trying, she is 100% on your side. Solid prof. Super interesting lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Acts nice but is passive aggressive. She will take her sweet time lecturing material and then realize there is only a week before the next midterm and rush through everything else. She says the exam questions aren't meant to trick you when clearly, many of them are. All she really does is reads off the slides but attend class for the bonus points.

Biology is a lot and its not exactly an "easy A" but her class was reasonable. Her and Angela Hawkins are some of your best options in my opinion. Random LC during lecture count towards extra credit so go to class. She was easy to understand and follow in class. Study problem set and LC questions for her exams. (3+final)
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Adams is such a sweet person. I really liked her, but sometimes her lectures could be quite boring, and she would tell us certain things were not important when they actually were. Her tests were relatively fair, although only people with a great memory/intense study regimen would do very well. She was always available thru office hours though
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: These lectures can be anywhere from 30-60 slides long. The class is disorganized and it doesnt prepare you for the test. Test questions are very analytical and often have lots of answer choices. The material was taught so quickly that I dont think I will remember anything from this course. Dont expect to get your grade to be rounded up either.
Decent lecturer. Possible to make an A. LOTS of extra credit opportunities. Final was pretty difficult.

Professor Adams is one of the poorest speakers I have ever witnessed, which isn't good considering that her job is giving lectures. She can kind of be rude and petty sometimes. However, I thought that her tests were fair, and the class is extremely easy to get an A in if you are good at memorization.

Biol 112 is just a hard class in general, profs matter but at the end of the day its about how much YOU work for it. 112 is A LOT of memorization and not very exciting but Adams does her best. Sometimes confuses herself (but don't we all) if something seems off go to APLUS and understand it. Adams is a solid choice, good person and will work with u

Adams is a nice person, but a really bad prof. She doesn't know how to teach & the exams are quite difficult. She contradicts the textbook & says some things aren't important when they are. If your anything, but a bio major & get her good luck. She also never answers emails & never tells you when grades are available.

Good person, bad prof. Doesn't even sound like she understands what she's teaching, contradicts textbook, says we won't be tested on certain things then are and gives vague in feedback. Went for office hours to ask why answers were right but instead gave me bad tips on how to study. Steer clear if you can or work your butt off to do mediocre.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: It really sucks that non bio majors get the worst profs. Literally she has no idea what she is talking about and cannot explain harder concepts. I took AP Bio in high school, but even so her class was just ridiculous. Honestly, it is very doable but you relly have to put in extra effort for an A. She is a very nice lady but not the best prof.

Adams wasnt the best professor Ive had but she was okay. Her tests were pretty difficult even for going to class regularly. Dont forget to do the problem sets and go to class for LC points. The lab for this class can kind of suck if you dont get a good TA but just go to office hours and have a really good lab group.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Much better prof than my bio 111, LC gives you 30 possible extra credit points which help a lot. good prof, tests are hard but not impossible, definitely not a good choice for a prof, enjoyed class.

Adams was a great professor, I enjoyed this course much more than BIOL111 because of how she formed her powerpoint and lectures. Biology is very material heavy and I found her exams very difficult, but not completely unrealistic. Problem sets are fairly easy and she makes the material as clear as possible.

Adams is a good overall prof. She makes herself very approachable and loves answering questions. Go to class for the extra credit and use the SI instructor. Her lectures can get boring but I think it's mostly because of the material. She posts her powerpoints online but go to lecture to do well on the tests.

Bio is a material heavy course, studying is essential for an A w any professor. Her powerpoints are concise and her presentations are more than simply reading slides. She often labels pictures/diagrams, don't just skim over those, they are important to tests! Many application questions. 30+ points of extra credit opportunities are available.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Pretty straightforward. Tests were straight from power points. If you memorize and understand all PowerPoint slides, you will make an A on the exams. Going to SI sessions are very helpful and help to summarize important information from lecture. She does LC as extra credit in lecture so always go because its quite a bit of extra credit.

Dr. Adams gives memorable examples for concepts and makes lectures interesting. There are problem sets due every week that consist of a couple of exam questions. After exams she has office hours where she goes through the questions you got incorrect which is very helpful. Reading the textbook isn't mandatory. SI sessions helped a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Adams plays fair with her tests. You need to read to excel in this class. Overall, she is a good professor. My only complaint is she does not tell her class when she will miss class, so there are days you walk in to a random, substitute professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Adams is hilarious and goofy. She cares about her students. The exams are hard, but read the textbook you will pass easily. Bio 112 is full of memorization of organism details, but Adams sets you up for success. She gets less recognition than she deserved. Lee came and taught one class and was monotone and rude, and I am so glad I took Adams!!

After seeing her rating i was nervous to take Adams but she is SO much better than given credit. All information is on her lecture slides and while she reads off the powerpoint in class, she does sneak in details that are important to catch for exams. BIO 112 is a lot of information but she helps provide ways to study it if you can put in the work.

I loved Dr. Adams class. Tests were straight from power points. If you memorize and understand all PowerPoint slides, you will make an A on the exams. I never read the book and got 100 on the first exam. Going to SI sessions with Beth really helped me. Go to as many as you can. I would take this class again in a heartbeat.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The only time this class was interesting was when she said something so dumb that it was appalling.

All these people saying people did bad bc they were on their phones are idiots. People were on their phones trying to catch up/get ahead on slide notes, because her slide speed is so goddamn random its hard to predict. Not saying this class was hard, just saying she was terrible, and Im pretty sure she made me dumber whenever I came to class.

You get the grade you work for! I do not agree with the negative ratings(half didnt show up to class/on phones). I rarely read the book and did well on exams because everything that was on the test, was covered in class or in lab. She had extra credit LC which added 30 points to overall score and the lectures were interesting and kept my attention.

I came from a world of AP in high school and her tests seemed easy and straightforward to me. I read the book, which I doubt many people did. There's no homework to reinforce student's learning. Her lectures are so vague that I stopped taking notes a few weeks in because she didn't say anything the slides didn't already have in them. Easy A for me.

Dr. Adam's wasn't great but not completely terrible. Her lectures were pretty vague and usually straight from the slides. Toward the end of the semester I only showed up for the possible LC extra credit. She would tell us stuff wouldn't be on the test and then test on that anyways. Her tests were worded confusingly and were very specific.

Amanda Adams is an awful professor. She was bad at lecturing and would test over different stuff. She had little to no office hours and when she did, she gave me an appointment that was 10 minutes and very rushed. She clearly does not care about her students and can not explain the answers from her exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Worst bio prof you could get. Nice woman, but clearly doesnt care about teaching-rarely responds to emails and barely has any office hours. She is often unable to elaborate on important topics, and even answers questions incorrectly. If she cant give correct and accurate info, Id rather she not mislead us and negatively affect what we know.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Adams is honestly a terrible prof. Went to her office hours and she called me an overachiever for wanting a B. She said she strives for and wants her students to get C's. She claims you dont need to know things and then puts them on the exam. Lecture and exams do not line up. Dont bother going to OH because she will just say to make a mind map.

If you can take any other teacher please do. Amanda's tests are very difficult and often go into further depth than what she teaches us. She swears she won't trick us but her test are far from "straight forward". One of the worst teachers I have had, her exam questions are also structured strangely and mislead your answer choice.10/10 not recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lovely and kind. Cares. However her tests and lectures do not align. Bio is a heavy info class. But her tests and exams are so hard and tricky. Its impossible to know everything she might ask. Combined with lackluster TA, this is the worse combination. Many of us want prof school and getting. B when working so hard is frustrating. no curve.

I found this class to be very interesting, and the professor always lectured in an easy to understand manner. While the exams are challenging and detailed, as long as you know everything listed in her lectures and actually understand what is written on the slides as well as read the textbook chapters, the exams are very doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Agree with a lot of the other comments. Nice as a person, but sub-par as a professor. The exams are much more detail-oriented than what she leads us to believe. Lectures are mostly read off the power points and don't go into detail. The substitute lecturers were always eye-opening as to the details we're missing out on. Read the textbook!

The people complaining on here about this class were probably never in class or on their phone the whole time. I noticed that less than half the class would show up and the ones that did were usually on their phone the whole time. Not the best professor, but she is a nice lady. If you stay off your phone and study, this class is easy.

She's a nice lady, but she often breezes over material that is tested on. She moves so quickly through the powerpoint and ends a 50 minute class early (often by 15 mins). The tests are heavily application based, and the notes don't match up to that. Definitely go through the textbook after taking notes from class!! I also agree w/ the other ratings

I really wanted to like Adams, she is a good person and does enjoy what she's doing, but her lectures are a worlds away difference from the content on the exams. The lectures are broad and she claims the tests will be about big picture as well, but they are very detail oriented and specific with application that we never practice in class.

Shes a really sweet lady and you can tell she really loves what shes teaching. The problem is there is so much material crammed in, and she says that the tests dont go deep, but... they do. You have to read because the ppts are so vague. The tests definelty trick you up.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Told us that the value of ferns comes from their decorative use, and that herbivore diets are less nutritious than carnivore diets. What is there left to say at this point. Cant even keep the differences between fish and amphibians straight.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is the worst professor that I've ever had so far. Her powerpoints doesn't go into that much detail but expect you to know everything in detail for the test. Her test is unreasonably hard for intro bio class. You basically watch the animal video in lecture 1/3 of time that is not really helpful. Sometimes she even get the material confused too

I don't mean to make assumptions, but it would be helpful to understand the content in your PowerPoint before your first lecture of the day. And don't claim that the class isn't meant to trick you when 75% of the exam is vague and nondescript. This lecture is miserable after you finish evolution, and student emails aren't THAT hard to respond to.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Says she won't assign more than 10 pages of reading/night, and then assigns 26 pages. Says she's not trying to trick you, and then gives a tricky exam. Claims she dislikes plants (huge part of the course). Doesn't make the PPTs and has difficulty pronouncing names and explaining. Doesn't finish material but tells you to know it anyways.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters
